newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to fly cargo during strike.
newsitem.headline: Air France to fly cargo during strike.

text.p: Air France Cargo said on Wednesday it would be maintaining several of its scheduled Boeing 747-200 freighter flights from Paris on Thursday, as strike action by the airline's pilots was set to continue.

"Five flights will be maintained from the eight freighter flights from Paris tomorrow normally scheduled for tomorrow -- Paris -Beirut-Bangkok, Paris-Karachi-Shanghai-Tokyo, Paris-Jeddah-Reunion-Mauritius-Entebbe, Paris-Bangalore-Karachi and Paris-Singapore," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
The official also confirmed the cancellation of tomorrow's Air France's 747F Dubai-Bombay-Madras service.

"As far as May 23 is concerned (the last scheduled day of strike action) we can already confirm that five freighter flights will operate normally -- Paris-Dubai-Bangkok-Osaka, Paris-Delhi-Kuwait, Paris-Chicago, Paris-Dubai-Hong Kong and Paris-Abu Dhabi-Taipei-Bangkok-Dubai, the official added.
"We have also postponed a Paris-New York freighter flight scheduled for May 23 to May 24," the official added.
Today, Air France was maintaining two of its seven scheduled Boeing 747-200 freighter services from Paris.

The strike is a resumption of a walkout that was threatened last month after talks with management broke down over a pay scale which would pay new pilots between nine and 30 percent less than current crews.

Air France said it was maintaining all its long-haul passenger flights despite the strike and around half of short-haul and a quarter of medium-haul flights were cancelled. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
